IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Public Safety.

Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the release of defendants charged with a sex or violent offense without the payment of bail pending trial.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to pretrial release programs; and adding a newsection to chapter 10.21 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 10.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A defendant charged with a sex or violent offense, as defined inRCW 9.94A.030, may not be released pending trial without the payment ofbail.
